profile.headline: Junior Specialist at University of California, Davis

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Led full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) of the SmartProbe platform, delivering and maintaining enterprise web and mobile applications for 20+ food and agricultural customers and 500+ deployed devices
• Designed, developed, and maintained scalable multi-tier applications using React, Node.js/Express REST APIs, MongoDB, and AWS across presentation, application, and data tiers
• Troubleshot a production dashboard issue with limited documentation by tracing frontend, API, and database behavior, eliminating an N+1 query pattern and reducing load times from approximately 8 seconds to under 0.5 seconds
• Implemented Git version control and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines to build, test, and automatically deploy frontends to Amazon S3 and backends to Elastic Beanstalk, reducing deployment time from 30 minutes to under 5 minutes
• Designed and built a dynamic push notification system with Firebase and Expo routing, per-user preferences, quiet hours, and scheduled AWS Lambda broadcasts for insect and rodent alerts on iOS and Android
• Implemented secure authentication using AWS Cognito, JWT, and RBAC to protect application data and enforce role-based access across multi-tenant customer environments
• Created API specifications, architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and user guides to support maintenance and onboarding
• Led three developers and mentored six engineering interns through Agile development, code reviews, debugging sessions, system design discussions, and production software releases
• Developed and executed unit, integration, regression, smoke, and user acceptance testing across web, mobile, and backend systems, identifying defects early in the SDLC and improving release stability

positions.title: Assistant Specialist
positions.description:
• Collaborated with agricultural customers, pest-control professionals, and researchers in grain mills and tree-nut facilities to turn operational needs into software features.
• Deployed and validated SmartProbe in those facilities for early detection of red flour beetles and Indian meal moths, including field troubleshooting and user acceptance testing.

positions.title: Junior Specialist
positions.description:
• Migrated SmartProbe off a lab member’s personal accounts onto a lab-owned stack (AWS, backend, and website), including access, environments, and source control so the group owned the system.
• Built the first SmartProbe mobile app using React Native and Expo for field and research use, including Bluetooth pairing and communication with the device for setup, data capture, and in-field troubleshooting.
• Took over an undocumented research codebase, reverse-engineered data-processing and device-communication logic, and added tests and documentation as the system moved toward production.

positions.title: Orientation Program Assistant
positions.description:
• Created and led advising programs to orientation leader staff
• Presented academic information to over 3000+ incoming student over 2 months
• Facilitated conversations surrounding the diversity of social identities
• Mentored student supervisors in professional development and academic success
